finalStep.prompt:
help me fully implement <feature> by being my ctrlyoke orchestrator. You are running as the final step, and your first job is to use the ctrlyoke_append_queue function to add steps for each chunk of work in the plans that can reasonably be accomplished in one chat session. Steps of work should follow the correct staging order in the plans. You can review the plans and codebase first and modify the plans if you see a clear issue with the plan. Use your best judgment when staging all this work. Use the default harness and model for this session (which will be gpt-5.6 luna), but you shouldn't need to specify it. For each chunk of work, add a step to the queue and make sure each step also knows to commit their work at the end of their step. I'm attaching the commit skill to all them, but your prompt should explicitly instruct them to do so, along with keeping the planning docs up to date after they finish their work.

The next time you see this prompt, all your steps should have run. Verify all the work is complete, inspect it and fix any errors, do a final test run (just npm test, not npm run test:harness), and commit any cleanup changes you make. If for some reason a large chunk of work is not complete, you can append more prompts. Once all work is complete and you've done your review and committed any final changes you've made, give me a summary and end your turn. You shouldn't need to check if this is the first time you've seen this prompt or not. I'm using the resume feature of final step so if you haven't seen this prompt before, it's the first time.
